name: openbrowser
description: CodeAgent MCP server with explicit application contexts, persistent namespaces, and isolated browser profiles
long_description:
OpenBrowser CodeAgent exposes create_context, execute_code, get_status, reset_browser, and close_context to 2026-07-28 MCP clients. create_context returns a server-minted context_id; later stateful calls pass that handle explicitly. execute_code runs Python with browser automation functions in a persistent per-context namespace. Older clients that negotiate 2024-11-05 through 2025-11-25 receive the original three-tool catalog and a legacy no-handle context.

### Key Features:
- **Explicit Contexts**: Modern clients create, use, and close isolated application contexts instead of relying on process identity
- **Code Execution**: Write Python code with async browser functions (await navigate, click, evaluate, etc.)
- **Persistent Namespace**: Variables and state persist between execute_code calls within one context
- **Recovery Tools**: get_status reports lifecycle and tab state without starting a browser; reset_browser closes a stuck browser while preserving user variables by default
- **Isolated Resources**: Each context has its own managed profile, workspace, default downloads directory, namespace, and locks
- **Legacy Compatibility**: Older stdio clients keep the original three tools without context IDs
- **Browser Automation**: Full browser control via CodeAgent functions
- **JavaScript Evaluation**: Run JS in page context via evaluate()
- **Data Libraries**: numpy, pandas, matplotlib, BeautifulSoup available
- **Standard Libraries**: json, csv, re, datetime, requests, asyncio, Path

tools.name: create_context
tools.description: Create an isolated OpenBrowser context and return its context_id. Does not start a browser until the first stateful call.

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description: Execute Python code in a persistent namespace with browser automation functions (navigate, click, evaluate, etc.). All functions are async -- use await.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Return OpenBrowser server, browser, profile, and tab state as JSON. Read-only and does not start a browser.

tools.name: reset_browser
tools.description: Close the current browser session and release its profile. User-defined Python variables are preserved unless clear_variables is true.

tools.name: close_context
tools.description: Close one OpenBrowser context and release its browser and profile. A successful close invalidates the handle.

prompts.name: scrape_data
prompts.description: Extract structured data from a website
prompts.text: First call create_context and keep its context_id. Then use execute_code with that context_id to write Python that navigates to {url}, extracts data using evaluate() for JS DOM queries or Python string processing, and prints structured results. Call close_context when finished.

prompts.name: fill_form
prompts.description: Fill out and submit a web form
prompts.text: First call create_context and keep its context_id. Then use execute_code with that context_id to navigate to {url}, get browser state to find form fields, and use input_text() and click() to fill and submit the form with: {field_data}. Call close_context when finished.

prompts.name: research_topic
prompts.description: Research a topic across multiple websites
prompts.text: First call create_context and keep its context_id. Then use execute_code with that context_id to navigate to multiple sites, extract content using evaluate() or page text, and aggregate findings about {topic} using Python data structures. Call close_context when finished.

workspace_directory.title: Workspace Directory
workspace_directory.description: Directory to use as workspace for downloads and file operations

headless.title: Headless Mode
headless.description: Run browser without GUI (faster, less memory). Set to false to see the browser window

stealth.title: Stealth Mode
stealth.description: Use stealth mode to avoid detection by anti-bot systems

user_data_dir.title: User Data Directory
user_data_dir.description: Optional explicit Chrome profile directory. Omit for an isolated profile per MCP server instance

storage_state.title: Storage State Path
storage_state.description: Optional JSON file used as a one-time seed for cookies plus localStorage in managed MCP profiles; later updates are saved to the active profile copy

disable_security.title: Disable Security
disable_security.description: Disable browser security features (CORS, CSP, etc). Use with caution

deterministic_rendering.title: Deterministic Rendering
deterministic_rendering.description: Force deterministic rendering for consistent screenshots. May break some sites

viewport_expansion.title: Viewport Expansion
viewport_expansion.description: Extra pixels to expand viewport for better LLM context understanding

allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains
allowed_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains the browser can access (e.g., 'example.com,*.google.com'). Leave empty for no restrictions

sensitive_data_masking.title: Sensitive Data Masking
sensitive_data_masking.description: Mask sensitive data (passwords, credit cards) in screenshots and logs

default_timeout.title: Default Timeout (ms)
default_timeout.description: Default timeout for browser operations in milliseconds

wait_between_actions.title: Wait Between Actions (seconds)
wait_between_actions.description: Time to wait between browser actions for stability

session_timeout.title: Session Timeout (minutes)
session_timeout.description: Minutes of inactivity before browser session auto-closes
